name: The Cure (style) — E minor 138
description: Modelled on the sound of The Cure — original parts, not any of their songs: a melodic picked bass high on the neck that carries the tune, chorused clean-guitar arpeggios, synth-string pads, tom-driven drums. E minor at 138 bpm, Em C G D. Rows 1-5 drums (ch 10), 6-9 bass SUBROUTINES and A-C bass rows (ch 13), D-G guitar SUBROUTINES and H guitar (ch 14), I string pad (ch 15), J-K lead melody (ch 11), L slow strings (ch 16), M-Q sections, R jam. Row 0 plays the song.
prompt: build a new bank modelled after the band The Cure and make one modelled after the band Depeche Mode and make one modelled after Joe Jackson
